chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Need for introspection, peace, and universal brotherhood. Silence helps us understand ourselves and stop harming nature and each other.

chapters.title: A Thing of Beauty by John Keats
chapters.subject: English

chapters.subject: English

chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Male domination in marriage, suppression of women, and art as an escape. The tigers show Aunt Jennifer’s inner desire for freedom.

chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Escapism, nostalgia for a simpler past, and the harshness of modern life. The third level is a metaphor for the human desire to escape stress and insecurity.

chapters.title: The Tiger King by Kalki
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Abuse of power, pride, fate, and satire on rulers who misuse power for vanity. The story also suggests that harming nature backfires.

chapters.title: Journey to the End of the Earth by Tishani Doshi
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Climate change, environmental responsibility, Earth’s history, and the need for global cooperation.

chapters.title: The Enemy by Pearl S. Buck
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Conflict between human compassion and national loyalty, duty as a doctor versus duty as a citizen, and humanity rising above hatred.

chapters.title: On the Face of It by Susan Hill
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Disability, loneliness, self-acceptance, empathy, and the importance of inner worth over outward appearance.

chapters.title: Memories of Childhood by Zitkala-Sa and Bama
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Racial discrimination, caste discrimination, cultural suppression, humiliation, resistance, and the power of education.

chapters.title: The Portrait of a Lady by Khushwant Singh
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: The bond between generations, the pain of changing relationships due to modernization, and the dignity of aging and death.

chapters.title: A Photograph by Shirley Toulson
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Human mortality, the transience of life compared to the permanence of nature, and the deep, silent grief of losing a mother.

chapters.title: We're Not Afraid to Die... if We Can All Be Together by Gordon Cook and Alan East
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Unity, family support, unwavering optimism, and presence of mind helping human beings endure and conquer hazardous crises.

chapters.title: Discovering Tut: the Saga Continues by A.R. Williams
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: How modern technology, forensic science, and archaeology come together to uncover long-buried historical secrets.

chapters.title: The Laburnum Top by Ted Hughes
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Mutual dependency and the transience of life explored through a symbiotic relationship between a tree and a bird.

chapters.title: The Ailing Planet: The Green Movement’s Role by Nani Palkhivala
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Deteriorating global health due to human exploitation and shifting perception toward an ecological worldview and sustainable development.

chapters.title: The Voice of the Rain by Walt Whitman
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Celebrating the eternal circular cycle of rain and drawing a parallel to how art and nature share a healing, life-giving power.

chapters.title: The Adventure by Jayant Narlikar
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Weaving historical speculation with quantum physics to explore parallel realities and transitions in human consciousness.

chapters.title: Childhood by Markus Natten
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: The loss of childhood innocence, the transition into rational adult life, and the painful realization of adult hypocrisy.

chapters.title: Silk Road by Nick Middleton
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Geographical harshness and physical challenges faced during high-altitude travel countered by unexpected human companionship.

chapters.title: Father to Son by Elizabeth Jennings
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: The generational communication gap and emotional alienation inside a familial environment, trapping two perspectives in a deadlock.

chapters.title: The Summer of the Beautiful White Horse by William Saroyan
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Childhood innocence, a shared love for freedom, and how a deep-seated pride in family values dictates moral choices.

chapters.title: The Address by Marga Minco
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Emotional trauma and material disruption caused by war, showcasing the ultimate futility of clinging to a tragic past.

chapters.title: Mother's Day by J.B. Priestley
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Satirical commentary on the unfair treatment of housewives and the necessity of establishing domestic respect.

chapters.title: Birth by A.J. Cronin
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Intense professional dedication and medical instinct triumphing over personal despair to protect human life.

chapters.title: The Tale of Melon City by Vikram Seth
chapters.subject: English
chapters.description: Satirizing arbitrary governance, blind adherence to tradition, and the absurdity of a purely mechanical legal system.

chapters.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It explains how substances transform into new products and teaches how to write, balance, and classify chemical equations.

chapters.title: Acids Bases and Salts
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It explores the chemical properties, reactions, and pH scales of acidic and basic substances, along with the formation and practical uses of various salts.

chapters.title: Metals and Non-Metals
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It covers the physical and chemical properties of metals and non-metals, ionic bond formation, and basic metallurgical extraction processes.

chapters.title: Carbon and its Compounds
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It explores the versatile bonding nature of carbon, hydrocarbons, functional groups, homologous series, and the chemistry of soaps and detergents.

chapters.title: Life Processes
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It explains the fundamental biological mechanisms required to maintain life, including nutrition, respiration, transportation, and excretion in living organisms.

chapters.title: Control and Coordination
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It investigates how animals and plants respond to external stimuli using nervous systems, involuntary reflex actions, and chemical hormones.

chapters.title: How do Organisms Reproduce?
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It details asexual and sexual modes of reproduction across different species alongside a focus on human reproductive systems and reproductive health.

chapters.title: Heredity
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It introduces basic genetics, tracking how traits are passed down through generations alongside Mendel's laws of inheritance and genetic sex determination.

chapters.title: Light – Reflection and Refraction
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It analyzes the phenomena of light reflection using spherical mirrors and refraction through lenses using numerical ray-tracking math.

chapters.title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It examines the anatomy of human vision, vision defects like myopia, and natural light scattering effects like rainbows and blue skies.

chapters.title: Electricity
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It defines current, potential difference, Ohm's law, electrical resistance factors, circuit configurations, and the heating effects of power.

chapters.title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It explains electromagnetic fields, magnetic force rules on conductors, solenoids, domestic circuits, and alternating vs direct current setups.

chapters.title: Our Environment
chapters.subject: Science
chapters.description: It dissects ecosystem components, food chains, energy flow, and major environmental concerns such as ozone layer depletion and waste management.
